a.description: Evaluated part node id of the first part.

aOwner.description: Source instance that owns each part.

confirmed.description:
Narrow-phase verdict: `null` when `precise` was not requested or the
triangle budget ran out.

gap.description: Signed separation in metres: negative is the penetration depth.

penetrating.description: True when the boxes penetrate, so `gap` is a depth rather than a gap.

ClashRequest.description:
Clash / clearance query over the evaluated scene.

`clearance` is a distance in metres: `0` (default) reports penetrations only,
anything larger also reports parts that come that close. `scope` is `owners`
(default, compare parts belonging to different source instances) or `parts`
(also compare parts of the same instance). `precise` asks for a triangle
narrow phase on penetrating candidates. `ownerIds` restricts the audit to
those source instances.

triangleBudget.description:
Triangle pairs examined per candidate in the narrow phase. Raise it when
big meshes come back `confirmed: null`; it is the only cost knob.

ReferenceAssetBinding.description:
一条语义绑定：把资产内的稳定选择标识映射到可寻址的实体。
行业属性一律放在 `metadata`，内核不认识任何具体字段。

hidden.description: 资产声明该绑定不应显示（例如已废弃构件）。

slot.description: 该绑定使用的材质槽位。为空时使用资产的默认材质。

displayExposure.description: 展示曝光系数。资产可声明自身材质整体偏暗需要提亮，内核只做数值传递。

materialSlots.description: 资产声明的可覆盖材质槽位。Viewer 按槽位取色，不解析节点名。

bindings.description: 语义绑定条目数。旧工程把该字段写作 `equipment`。

ReferenceMaterialSlot.description: 资产发布方声明的材质槽位。`color` 是资产的默认表现，可被工程覆盖。

bindingManifestPath.description: 资产发布方提供的语义绑定清单路径。

equipmentManifestPath.description: 早期客户端使用的同义字段，读取时回退。
